question: In order to claim the accumulation of income, trusts or charitable institutions must file Form 9A and Form 10 at least ________ prior to the deadline for filing the return of income as per Finance Bill 2023.
solution:
The correct answer is **2 months. ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Form** **9A**:

 
 
• This form is typically used by charitable or religious trusts to provide information about the accumulation or setting aside of income for charitable or religious purposes.
 
 
 
• **Form** **10**:
 
 
• This form is used by charitable institutions to furnish details about their income, activities, and the steps taken for the accumulation of income for charitable purposes.
 
 
 
• **Accumulation of Income**:
 
 
• Charitable trusts or institutions may accumulate income for specific purposes outlined in the Finance Bill, such as charitable or religious activities.
 
 
 
• **Filing Deadline**:
 
 
• The question mentions filing Form 9A and Form 10 at least 2 months prior to the deadline for filing the return of income.
 
 
 
• **Finance Bill 2023**:The Finance Bill typically outlines the financial proposals of the government for the upcoming fiscal year, including tax-related provisions.
 
• Some of the highlights of **Finance Bill 2023 **is given below:
 
 
• Proposed Changes in Tax Rates:
 
 
• Basic exemption limit under Section 115BAC revised to INR 3,00,000 with a 30% slab rate for income above INR 15,00,000.
 
• Threshold for rebate under Section 87A increased from INR 5,00,000 to INR 7,00,000 in the new tax regime.
 
• Surcharge rate reduced from 37% to 25% for income above INR 5,00,00,000.
 
• Section 115BAC applies to AOP, BOI, and AJP.
 
• Section 115BBJ proposes a 30% tax rate on online gaming winnings.
 
 
 
• Amendments for Charitable & Religious Trusts:
 
 
• Utilization of corpus, loans, or borrowings prior to 01-04-2021 not considered if returned.
 
• Repayment of loan/investment for charitable purposes within 5 years deemed valid.
 
• Donations between trusts deemed an application up to 85% of the donated amount.
 
• Accumulation of income requires filing Form 9A and Form 10 two months before the income return deadline.
 
 
 
• Deductions and Exemptions:
 
 
• Receipts from life insurance exceeding INR 5,00,000 considered income if policy issued after April 1, 2023.
 
• Section 10AA deduction allowed if proceeds from goods/services sale received within 6 months.
 
• Exemption under Section 10(22B) for news agencies withdrawn.
